params.body:
## Why

The new mail theme printed this in the footer of every mail:

> Ziet deze mail er vreemd uit? Dezelfde boodschap reist als platte tekst mee in dit bericht.

It explains the multipart alternative, which is a property of the medium, not of the message.
No reader acts on it, and as a question it reads as an apology for the mail they are holding.
Right underneath it, the footer printed the no-reply sender address a second time: the client
already shows the sender, and a mailto to a mailbox nobody reads is a dead end.

## What was removed

- `ui.mail_footer_plain` in `resources/lang/nl/ui.php` and `resources/lang/en/ui.php`, and the
  line that printed it. Those were the only two languages carrying the key, so no orphan is
  left behind; there is no translation-parity test in `tests/`.
- The repeated `no-reply@stocklistdealer.eu` in the identity line. The brand name now carries
  `contact@stocklistdealer.eu`, the same address the Contact link above it points to. The
  sender stays `no-reply@stocklistdealer.eu` and no `Reply-To` header is added.

## What the footer says now

Four things, in this order, and nothing else:

1. the three links the app carries under every page: Handleiding, Nieuw in Stocklist, Contact;
2. who sent it and how to reach a person: `Stocklistdealer.eu · contact@stocklistdealer.eu`;
3. why it arrived: "Je krijgt deze mail omdat je een Stocklist-account hebt.";
4. the copyright line.

Reviewed with the same eye and kept as is: the header (app name, linked to the app) and the
subcopy block. No tracking pixel and no unsubscribe link, which is correct for transactional
mail, and that reason is now written down in the template comment.

**The preheader needed no change.** `layout.blade.php` emits the hidden line only when a mail
sets `@slot('preheader', ...)`, and no mailable does, so the div is simply absent from all 26
rendered previews. It never repeated the removed sentence. The slot stays available for a mail
that has real first words to show.

**Two gaps that surfaced while reading the footer in both languages.** `footer_manual`,
`footer_release_notes` and `footer_support` existed only in `nl/ui.php`, so an English reader
(and `fallback_locale` is `en`) saw the raw keys `ui.footer_manual` in both the mail footer and
the app footer; they are now in `en/ui.php` as well. And `All rights reserved.` had no Dutch
translation, so a Dutch mail ended in an English sentence; added to `resources/lang/nl.json`.
No new copy beyond those translations of strings that already existed.

## Preview paths

`php artisan stocklist:mail-preview` renders 26 views, 0 failed, under
`storage/app/mail-preview/`. Read in full:

- `storage/app/mail-preview/lead.html`
- `storage/app/mail-preview/export_mail.html`
- `storage/app/mail-preview/open_worklist_items.html`

Footer as rendered, Dutch:

> Handleiding Nieuw in Stocklist Contact · Stocklistdealer.eu · contact@stocklistdealer.eu ·
> Je krijgt deze mail omdat je een Stocklist-account hebt. · © 2026 Stocklist Dealer. Alle
> rechten voorbehouden.

and English:

> Manual What's new in Stocklist Contact · Stocklistdealer.eu · contact@stocklistdealer.eu ·
> You are receiving this e-mail because you have a Stocklist account. · © 2026 Stocklist
> Dealer. All rights reserved.

## Verified

- `php artisan view:cache` and `php -l` on every compiled view: clean.
- `php artisan test --filter='Mail|Smoke|Translation|Lang'`: 244 assertions, no failures.
